style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontFamily=PingFang SC;fontSize=21;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=10;fillColor=#EDF3FB;strokeColor=#7890A3;fontColor=#243B4D;"><mxGeometry x="340" SC;fontSize=21;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=10;fillColor=#EAF5EF;strokeColor=#7890A3;fontColor=#243B4D;"><mxGeometry x="340" y="546" width="260" height="108" as="geometry"
